_comment: PostToolUse hook: appends a timestamped audit record to /tmp/claude-audit.log every time Claude uses the Edit tool. Adapt the log path to suit your environment.

PostToolUse._comment: Matcher 'Edit' fires on the built-in Edit tool. Change to 'Write' or 'Bash' to audit other tool types.

hooks._comment: CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT contains the JSON-encoded tool input (file path, old string, new string). CLAUDE_TOOL_OUTPUT contains the result. Both are available in PostToolUse hooks.
